title: Stop button in the Assistant
feature: The user can stop a run while the Assistant works. After the stop, the composer is ready and a new message gets a reply. The Assistant screens look the same as on master.

scenarios.title: Stop a run in the middle
scenarios.expected: The stop button shows during the run. A click ends the run without an error message. The send button comes back, and a follow-up message gets a reply.

scenarios.title: A prompt gets a reply
scenarios.expected: A short prompt opens a new thread and gets the reply OK. The composer is ready after the reply.

scenarios.title: Assistant home and chat history
scenarios.expected: The home screen and the chat history popover look the same as on master.

scenarios.title: Thread with one reply
scenarios.expected: A thread with one short exchange looks the same as on master.
